shotgun.why: 2026-10-13 (heavy lane, fourth agent; bug-3681 follow-up): the eye sat OVER the receiver's rear end (eye -> virtual rear point 10.1 u), so the receiver was a blurred hump filling the lower middle of the screen and the bead a 6 px nub. relief 14.11 = the rig's clamp (+4 u): the eye is 4 u behind the receiver and looks along its top; delta 30 mrad (was 18; the shared sights.json says 18, cg_adssights.h said 4 until ads-heavy-next 89c08278): the whole barrel top shows between the receiver and the bead. Ships ONLY together with the staged mesh (tools/stage_sgsight.py: bead + receiver groove surfaces, 14 tiks, shader, textures)

fg42_irons.why: 2026-10-13 (heavy lane, fifth agent): the iron-sight FG 42 (tools/fg42irons.py). F = the rebuilt front post's tip, R = the centre of the rear aperture ring; relief = eye to the aperture. New gun: 8 rows inserted by tools/apply_fg42irons.py. Ships only with the staged mesh, tiks, shader and texture.

m1919.why: 2026-10-13 (heavy lane, seventh agent; bug-3622): the cgame had NO sight row for the M1919 portable (the shared sights.json key is a synthetic line under the receiver, never generated into cg_adssights.h) and the mesh no front sight - the aim was a black receiver wall. F = the tip of the new front blade on the trunnion block, R = the shoulders of the new notch slider in the rear leaf's window (tools/m1919sights.py), the line parallel to the bore 2.9 u above the receiver's top; relief = eye to the leaf. One row (the gun has no finish tiks), inserted by tools/apply_mgsights.py. Ships only with the staged mesh, tik, shader and texture.
